forbids: a board decision rendered as a raw Python dict repr instead of its text
note: BL-209. This guard shipped green over a LIVE instance of the defect it exists for. `C.esc()` calls str() then html.escape(), so a decision object reaches the page as `{'text': ...}` and a grep for the literal `{'text'` finds nothing on a page made of them (BL-199). The previous proof file diagnosed this correctly, in writing, and then chose a mutation that stepped around it — `_dtext` returning "" — so what was proved was that the text reaches the page, not that the repr never does. Meanwhile risk-register/renderers/render_report.py was shipping the escaped repr to a reader. Both halves below are now the real defect, and the guard sees both because it greps the escaped form and refuses to read a page the renderer never wrote.

mutations.why: the shipped P1 itself: the decision object stringified into the page. esc() escapes the repr's quotes, which is exactly why the old grep could not see it.
defeats: no raw dict repr in rendered decisions
